messages:
maya (eng-platform): Quick async — pulse on the usage-metering pipeline for the sprint. Need three things: clear owners, finalized event schema, and a smoke/canary result. Can we confirm owners and whether we can run a canary tomorrow?

liam (eng-ml): I can own the final schema + mapping to model vs route. PR up: https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/452 — CI is running. Event sample in the PR: 
```
{
  "event": "model.infer",
  "route": "/api/generate",
  "model": "redwood-v2-q4",
  "tokens": 1234,
  "cost_usd": 0.023,
  "latency_ms": 180,
  "cached_prefix": false
}
```

sam (eng-sre): CI was flaky this morning, I'm stabilizing the infra tests (failing auth mock). Expect green in ~2h. Canary plan suggestion: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with automatic rollback if token-cost delta > 10% or tail latency (p95) increases > 200ms.

tina (eng-ml): Heads up: quantized model variants change tokenization a bit due to prompt trimming heuristics. I'll add a normalization step in the collector to make token counts comparable across model variants and a unit test for it.

maya (eng-platform): @liam @tina please add an explicit `owners` field to the schema and a short normative description for cost attribution (billing vs product analytics). Also include an example for the prefix-cached case (cached_prefix = true).

liam (eng-ml): on it. Quick question for product: do we attribute billing at the route level or model level? We can record both, but need to know billing priority. @anna (product)

anna (product): prefer billing attributed to route (so customers see cost by API route), but keep per-model attribution for engineering/ops dashboards. So billing=route, analytics=model. :+1:

sam (eng-sre): FYI deploy-bot shows infra capacity in us-west-2 is good for the planned canary window. Nothing blocking on host capacity. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC for 30m. Automated: will run health probes and token-cost smoke checks.

maya (eng-platform): Plan recap: liam — finalize schema + update PR by EOD PST; sam — finish CI fixes and validate canary infra; tina — add collector normalization test and a short eval against quantized models; I’ll schedule the canary in Console once PR is merged. If anyone is blocked, ping me here. :wave:
